about: Question candidates for the answer hub. The weekly brief (.github/workflows/answers-weekly.yml) lists the first open ones. Each must be answerable from a named repository source; mark status 'published' with the slug once a post ships, or 'dropped' with a reason. See docs/23-answer-hub.md.
